ideas.title: Uncovering the Extent of Minnesota's Social-Welfare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota's social-welfare programs and uncover the full extent of the fraud
questions: What is the total amount of alleged fraud in Minnesota's social-welfare programs?
How many individuals and organizations are involved in the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in Minnesota's social-welfare programs. By following the money and analyzing data, we can uncover the full extent of the fraud and hold those responsible accountable.
